svg.text: Social Media Analytics — Data Pipeline Architecture
Simulated social posts → Apache NiFi → Apache Kafka → Spark Streaming & Batch → Hashtag Sentiment + Engagement Reports
likes and retweet counts on demand
Polls API every 5 s via HTTP.
NiFi UI: localhost:8080 | Kafka broker: localhost:9092 | Spark UI: localhost:8081
tests/test_pipeline.py — checks sentiment labels, API schema, sample data, and hashtag extraction
The agency receives real-time hashtag sentiment for live campaign monitoring
plus repeatable daily engagement reports — both from the same Kafka stream.
Social Media Analytics Platform | IronHack Capstone | Stack: Python · Apache NiFi · Apache Kafka · PySpark · Docker
